items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day is the printed letter date, 18.11.2026. The letter itself states the deemed-delivery rule: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.' Counting the posting day as day 0: 18.11 (+1)=19.11, (+2)=20.11, (+3)=21.11, (+4)=22.11.2026 → deemed delivery = Sunday, 22.11.2026. A statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse) is a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, where (unlike tax offices under § 108 Abs. 3 AO) the deemed-delivery day itself does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. So Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). This is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
